mapper.select: select max( tam.id ) ID, tam.mix_area mix_area, tam.material_name material_name, listagg ( tlm.MACHINE_NAME, ',' ) within GROUP ( ORDER BY tam.machine_order ) AS MACHINE_NAME, listagg ( tam.MACHINE_CODE, ',' ) within GROUP ( ORDER BY tam.machine_order ) AS MACHINE_CODE, listagg ( tam.machine_order, ',' ) within GROUP ( ORDER BY tam.machine_order ) AS MACHINE_ORDER, max( tam.remark ) remark, max( tam.del_flag ) del_flag, max( tam.create_by ) create_by, max( tam.create_time ) create_time, max( tam.update_by ) update_by, max( tam.update_time ) update_time from t_accessories_machine tam inner join (select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = '0' union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = '0') tlm on tam.MIX_AREA=tlm.MIX_AREA and tam.MACHINE_CODE=tlm.machine_code where tam.del_flag = '0' and tam.mix_area = #{mixArea} and tam.material_name=#{materialName} group by tam.MIX_AREA,tam.material_name

SELECT M.MACHINE_CODE, M.MACHINE_NAME FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R INNER JOIN T_LHFL_MACHINE M ON M.MACHINE_CODE = R.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE WHERE R.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND R.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME = #{materialName,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND R.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea,jdbcType= VARCHAR} GROUP BY M.MACHINE_CODE, M.MACHINE_NAME ORDER BY MACHINE_NAME
